items.text: The world of CODE VEIN II continues to expand with the arrival of Free Update 2.0, a major content update filled with new adventures, gameplay features, and customization options for all players.
Whether you're returning after completing the main story or looking for new challenges to conquer!
Here are some additional options...
・The Age of Harmony: A brand-new epilogue that takes place after the Miraculous Bonds ending.
・Trials of Remembrance: It introduces a series of combat challenges featuring bosses and enemies encountered throughout the main adventure.
・Partner Jadwiga: She can join with us not only with Assimilation, but also a Summoning partner!
・Story-Focused Mode: This optional setting strengthens the player character, making exploration and boss battles more accessible while preserving the narrative experience.
・Also, we fixed another bugs and issues.
Be sure to update your game to the latest version.
Full Patch Notes
The Patch Notes for Ver. 1.0.9 are now available for CODE VEIN II.
Please make sure to apply this patch with important updates before playing.

notes.title: Thank you for your continued support of CODE VEIN II.
Please note that the Update Ver. 1.0.4/1.0.5 has been released. We apologize for the inconvenience, but please install the latest update before playing.
Ver. 1.0.4/1.0.5 includes improvements to responsiveness, localized stability fixes, and frame rate enhancements in Action-Priority mode.

Gameplay Improvements
Reduced model processing load for certain boss and field enemies.
Fixed an issue where the frame rate would temporarily drop after fast traveling.
Feature additions and improvements
Added character customization parts
Added the accessory "Bangs".
Player motion improvements
Changed the player's posture during walking and running motions.
Sound improvements
Changed the sound effects (SE) upon successfully performing certain actions.
Upon successful parry
Upon successful back attack
Upon successful enemy break
Adjusted the volume balance of field environmental sounds.
Other improvements
Placed additional "Resurrection Monuments".
Changed the behavior to disable mouseover when a controller and mouse are connected simultaneously.
Balance Adjustments
To optimize the balance of action advantage between the player and enemies, we have implemented the following adjustments.
Player Action Adjustments
Improved the response of player actions.
Hastened the timing at which evasion actions (Step, Rolling, Heavy Rolling) can be performed after an attack.
Hastened the timing at which guarding can be performed after an attack.
Increased rolling speed.
Hastened the timing at which the next roll, guard, or jump can be performed after rolling.
Hastened the timing at which the next action can be performed after using "Regeneration".
Hastened the timing at which the next action can be performed after using trap-type items.
Hastened the timing at which the next action can be performed when the player is staggered by an enemy attack.
Hastened the timing at which the next action can be performed when the player gets up after being blown back by an enemy attack.
Changed "Regeneration" and item usage to accept buffered inputs.
Increased the attack speed of certain attacks.
All normal attacks for weapons in the "Hammer" category
Increased the attack speed for the following Weapon Formae.
Endless Onslaught
Dive Bomb
Backdraft
Fortress Stance
Coffin Breaker

Wraith's Fury
Vanquisher

Blazing Roar

Lightning Shower
Lightning Chain
Diamond Dust
Guard of Honor
Frost Wave
Ice Spikes

Air Blast

Coffin Breaker
Coffin Breaker – Sweeper

Enemy Adjustments
Adjusted the action intervals of certain boss enemies to increase the windows of opportunity for player attacks.
Shortened the invincibility time when enemies are downed, hastening the timing for follow-up attacks.
Adjusted certain field enemies to stagger more easily from player attacks.
Removed the stagger resistance modifier that certain field enemies had during attack animations.
Adjusted enemies with raised shields so their stance can be broken more easily with attacks.
Parameter Adjustments
Adjusted the "Enemy Stagger Ease" applied to player attacks.

In conjunction with the enhancements to player actions and adjustments to enemy stagger susceptibility, we have adjusted the "Enemy Stagger Ease" set for player attacks. Balance has been improved by adjusting both values that were too low and those that were too high.
Increased the Enemy Stagger Ease for the following attacks.
Weak attacks for weapons in the "Halberd" category

Flash Javelin
Chariot Reave

Decreased the Enemy Stagger Ease for the following attacks.

Manus Rapacis
Adjusted the "Break Value" set for player attacks. The "Break Value" is the power to break an attacked enemy; attacks with a higher "Break Value" will break enemies more easily.

Similar to "Enemy Stagger Ease", we have adjusted the "Break Value" in conjunction with enhancements to player actions and adjustments to enemy stagger susceptibility. Balance has been improved by tuning down values that were too high.
Decreased the Break Value of the following attacks.
Charged strong attacks for certain one-handed swords (e.g., Ancient Hunter's Sword)

We have released update Ver.1.0.2 for the CODE VEIN II Character Creator Demo.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where performing specific actions could cause saved appearance data to be deleted within the "Save/Delete Appearance" menu in Character Customization.
Please update to the latest version to ensure the best experience.
Ver. 1.0.3 will be released today, Jan 30 (Fri) at 8:00AM CET.
▼Update Contents
Fixed an issue where saved appearance data in Character Creator("Save/Delete Appearance") was unintentionally deleted during specific actions.
▼Target Product
CODE VEIN II (Base Game)
After applying this patch, the previously announced "Workaround" is no longer necessary for the full version.

Important Note: Players using the Demo Version must continue to use the workaround for now. We are currently preparing a fix for the Character Creator Demo and will announce the release timing once confirmed. (Note: Appearance data can still be transferred from the Demo to the Full Version.)
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Regional Pathos
Added "Regional Pathos".

"Regional Pathos" is the manifestation of the strong emotions of those who lived in this world. By offering prayers to these Pathos found in the field, the player can receive divine protection. This protection grants various benefits to the player while within the area influenced by the Pathos.
Restorative Offering
Added "Restorative Offering".

"Restorative Offering" is an ability where your Buddy shares their life force to heal you when the player runs out of strength. When Restorative Offering is activated, the Partner will be unable to act for a certain period of time.
